results.name: inventory_export_is_stable
results.evidence: 库存导出字段固定、按 SKU 排序，且门面/导出/v2 账本的 available 是同一个数

results.name: stock_never_negative
results.evidence: 缺货请求被拒绝，库存未发生部分写入

results.name: receiving_is_idempotent
results.evidence: 重复入库键只生效一次

results.name: cancellation_releases_reservation
results.evidence: 取消 reserved 订单后完整释放预占

results.name: illegal_transition_is_blocked
results.evidence: draft 订单不能跳过预占直接发货

results.name: purchase_requires_approval
results.evidence: 未审批被阻断，审批后可入库

results.name: purchase_request_preserves_reason
results.evidence: 采购申请保留 SKU、数量、原因和稳定身份，无效数量或空白原因没有部分写入

results.name: order_total_matches_lines
results.evidence: 订单总额与明细计算一致

results.name: ecommerce_channel_order_is_idempotent_and_guarded
results.evidence: 渠道订单重放幂等，审单生成销售单并原子预占，缺货订单保留异常且未超卖

results.name: channel_callback_lease_is_exclusive_and_bounded
results.evidence: 渠道回传仅允许一个具名 Worker 持有租约；越权确认被阻断，失败保留证据并进入有界退避

results.name: production_schema_invariants
results.evidence: 生产 Schema、权限字典、外键与数据库完整性检查通过

results.name: multi_location_transfer_conserves_stock
results.evidence: 跨库位调拨前后库存总量守恒，来源与目标账一致

results.name: stale_stock_count_is_blocked
results.evidence: 盘点快照后发生库存变化，过账被可靠阻断

results.name: sales_credit_and_atomic_reservation
results.evidence: 正式销售两行正常预占、第二行缺货、第二次写入失败均已检查；失败后四表完整不变

results.name: backup_is_restorable
results.evidence: 在线备份校验和、解压与 SQLite 完整性复验全部通过

results.name: purchase_invoice_three_way_match
results.evidence: 采购订单、已过账收货与供应商发票的数量和单价匹配通过，超收发票被阻断

results.name: payable_aging_tracks_open_supplier_exposure
results.evidence: 应付账龄按到期日分桶，部分付款只保留未结余额，并与驾驶舱逾期应付一致

results.name: double_entry_fifo_and_subledger_reconciliation
results.evidence: FIFO 销售成本、复式凭证、收款核销及库存/应收子账总账自动对账全部通过

results.name: bank_statement_control_and_reconciliation
results.evidence: 不平对账单被阻断，银行流水自动匹配收付款后与银行存款总账余额一致
